The R0.6 test robustness repair has been completed using native bounded file tools only (no shell, git, or command execution). Only [`tests/test_harness_calendar.py`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/tests/test_harness_calendar.py) and [`coordination_evidence/agy_1010_calendar_testfix_report.md`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/coordination_evidence/agy_1010_calendar_testfix_report.md) were modified; all production sources remain untouched.

---

### Root Cause Verification

1. **`LegacyIsTodayTests.test_season_matches_weather` (`tick=150`)**:
   - [`weather.season_for_tick`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/systems/nature/weather.py#L93-L99) delegates to [`calendar.season_for_tick`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/harness/calendar.py#L198-L199), which calls `active().season_for_tick(tick)`.
   - Under ambient `EDEN_CALENDAR=1`, `active()` resolves to `cal.USER` (96,000 ticks/year; spring is 24,000 ticks). At tick 150, `150 / 96000 < 0.25`, yielding `"spring"`.
   - `cal.LEGACY.season_for_tick(150)` operates on the legacy 600-tick year (150 ticks/season), where tick 150 is `0.25` of the year, yielding `"summer"`.
   - Because `test_season_matches_weather` lacked environment isolation, it inherited the ambient `EDEN_CALENDAR=1` flag and failed.

2. **`LegacyIsTodayTests.test_block_matches_the_resolver` (`tick=500`)**:
   - [`resolver.tick_to_time_block`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/systems/schedule/resolver.py#L19-L30) checks `calendar_enabled()`. Under ambient `EDEN_CALENDAR=1`, calls with the default length (2,400 ticks) delegate to `cal.USER.block_for_tick(tick)`.
   - For `cal.USER`, dawn in spring is `[0, 500)`. At tick 500, dawn has ended and the block is `"day"`.
   - `cal.LEGACY.block_for_tick(500)` divides the 2,400-tick day into four equal quarters of 600 ticks; `500 // 600 == 0`, yielding `"dawn"`.
   - Because `test_block_matches_the_resolver` lacked environment scoping, it inherited ambient `EDEN_CALENDAR=1` and failed.

---

### Exact Fixes Applied

In [`tests/test_harness_calendar.py`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/tests/test_harness_calendar.py):

1. **Class-Level Environment Isolation**:
   - Added `setUp` with `patcher = mock.patch.dict(os.environ, clear=False); patcher.start(); self.addCleanup(patcher.stop)` to all test classes (`LegacyIsTodayTests`, `UserCalendarTests`, `ResolverDelegationTests`, and `RatesAndFlagTests`). This prevents cross-test or cross-class environment leakage regardless of test outcome.

2. **Explicit Flag-Off Scoping (`EDEN_CALENDAR` Absent & `"0"`)**:
   - Parameterized flag-off execution in `test_season_matches_weather`, `test_block_matches_the_resolver`, `test_flag_off_the_module_accessors_are_legacy`, and `test_flag_off_is_the_old_function` across both `EDEN_CALENDAR=None` (popped/absent) and `EDEN_CALENDAR="0"`.
   - Preserved **all original exhaustive assertions** (all 7,000+ deterministic & pseudorandom ticks, float boundary ticks, and all day-length variations).

3. **Meaningful Nested External Flag-On Restoration Assertions**:
   - Added nested external assertions testing real consumer entry points (`weather`, `resolver`, `cal`) rather than self-mirroring `os.environ` checks:
     - Outer block runs with `mock.patch.dict(os.environ, ON)` verifying USER behavior (`weather` at tick 150 is `"spring"`, `resolver` at tick 500 is `"day"`).
     - Inner block pops `EDEN_CALENDAR` verifying reversion to LEGACY behavior (`"summer"` and `"dawn"`).
     - Exiting inner block asserts complete restoration of outer flag-on behavior (`"spring"` and `"day"`).

---

### Flag-Sensitive Behavior Summary

| Operation | Flag-Off (`absent` / `"0"`) | Flag-On (`"1"`) | Verified In |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cal.active()` | `cal.LEGACY` | `cal.USER` | `RatesAndFlagTests`, `LegacyIsTodayTests` |
| `weather.season_for_tick(150)` | `"summer"` (150/600 = 0.25) | `"spring"` (150/96000 = 0.00156) | `LegacyIsTodayTests` |
| `resolver.tick_to_time_block(500)` (default 2400) | `"dawn"` (500 < 600) | `"day"` (dawn ends at 500) | `LegacyIsTodayTests`, `ResolverDelegationTests` |
| `resolver.tick_to_time_block(t, 1000)` | 4 equal quarters (250 ticks) | 4 equal quarters (250 ticks) | `LegacyIsTodayTests`, `ResolverDelegationTests` |

The detailed verification report has been written to [`coordination_evidence/agy_1010_calendar_testfix_report.md`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/coordination_evidence/agy_1010_calendar_testfix_report.md). The test suite maintains all 19 tests and is ready for root re-run in both ambient environment modes (`EDEN_CALENDAR=1` and `EDEN_CALENDAR=0`/unset). R0.6 remains pending separate calendar scenario and market scenario subprocess checks.
